settings.title: Settings
settings.cost_legend: LOW / MED / HIGH indicate performance cost. If frames stutter, turn HIGH items off first.

display.section_caption: What the world draws, and at what resolution

decor.label: Decor
decor.description: Shows the trees, cars and other decor placed on the terrain. Objects you placed are not affected.

clouds.label: Clouds
clouds.description: Shows the puffy clouds in the sky and the thin cloud layers above them. They fade out as the camera climbs high.

textures.label: Textures
textures.description: Textures cube faces instead of a flat color.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Draws at the device's resolution, lowering it for a while when frames stutter and restoring it once there is room.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.description: Always draws at the device's resolution. Sharpest, but may stutter on slower devices.

low.label: Low
low.description: Draws at a lower resolution to save battery and heat. Looks a little softer.

tilt_lock.label: Lock tilt
tilt_lock.description: Fixes the tilt; turns left and right only.

orbit_obstacle.label: Third-person collision

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Stops the camera control just short of the obstacle.

climb.label: Climb over
climb.description: Tilts the camera up to climb over what blocks it. Stops where the way up is blocked too.

orbit_obstacle.description: Controls what happens when zooming, turning, or tilting would move the camera into terrain or an object.

edge_shade.label: Cube Outlines
edge_shade.description: Darkens only edges exposed to open air, keeping flat ground seamless while outlining changes in height.

off.label: Off
off.description: Applies uniform ambient lighting to all surfaces.

corner.label: Corners
corner.description: Darkens contact areas and inside corners so cubes look grounded instead of floating. Light on performance.

screen.label: Detailed (SSAO)
screen.description: Adds detailed contact shadows to corners and crevices for greater depth. This is the most demanding option because it processes the entire screen.

rim_light.label: Rim Light
rim_light.description: Adds a subtle highlight around the edges of cubes, decor and characters to make them stand out from the background.

debug.section_caption: Diagnostics for the view and the scheduler

view_overlay.label: View Overlay
view_overlay.description: Shows where the camera and the pointer are: distance, angles, τ, coordinates and the cell zoom under the pointer.

performance_overlay.label: Performance Overlay
performance_overlay.description: Shows frame timing, GPU, drawing, requests and memory, and records them while on.

world_gizmo.label: World Gizmo
world_gizmo.description: Draws the view center, its cell and the axis rings, and the drawn pieces, their tiles and shards, in the world with a legend, for debugging.

disclaimer.demo_notice: This service is a demo. Data may be lost or the service may be discontinued without notice.
disclaimer.coverage_notice: Currently, only South Korea is supported. All other regions are displayed as ocean.
disclaimer.storage_notice: Objects you place are stored only on this device and are not saved to the server.
disclaimer.location_notice: Your location data is neither collected nor stored.
disclaimer.character_notice: Characters and decor use the CC0-licensed Kenney asset pack.
